items.title: Try a 10 to 20 minute walk after dinner
items.text: Walking after dinner is linked to a rise about 18.3 mg/dL smaller in the same person. Walking 10 to 19 minutes got most of the gain: 17.5 mg/dL less.

items.title: Move dinner earlier
items.text: Sugar rose about 9.2 mg/dL more after late dinners than after earlier ones in the same person. Try to start dinner before 8 pm, as sugar rose 13.3 mg/dL more after a dinner at 8-9 pm than after one before 6 pm.

items.title: Aim for a 13-hour overnight break
items.text: In the randomized program, adding the overnight fast to coaching changed HbA1c by -0.03 points. Your overnight fast averaged 6.6 hours, and 0.0% of nights reached 13 hours.
